text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Oh, there you are! Heeey!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
So, you're one of the trainers who came up
to me after tryouts, right?
Right?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Follow me, I'm gonna test you!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Well you see, after you left, Prez told me
to "Consider each trainer
carefully, then
choose one in whom you can place your
trust."

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
So I thought, what better way than to have
a trial training session? So
today, I'll be
testing you! ♪ Show me your best training
skills.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: ...Well, guess I'm Teio's trainer for the day.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, a hopping exercise? So I'm supposed
to navigate this mini
hurdle course on just
one foot...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Sounds kinda fun! What's the time to
beat?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I show her the goal I'd set, which was supposed to be on the difficult side.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Whaaat, that's it? Easy-peasy! Be back in a
flash!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As promised, she's back seemingly no
sooner than she had dashed
off, well
before the target time.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Phew... Sooo, is that it? I can run lots
more!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I give her a few more exercises to try, and
she shatters expectations
on each one.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
All done! So? Set some pretty nice records
there, didn't I?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Right? Hehe. C'mon, let the invincible
Teio know just how incredible
she is!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Mhm. I've never lost to anyone, you see. I
win every single race, and
everyone
showers me with praise!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Which feels amazing, by the way. ♪ All the compliments show that people really do think the world of me.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Like at my very first race, after I took first,
everyone came up to me
and was like "You
were incredible!"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Honestly, I just couldn't get enough of it!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
And once I'm in the Twinkle Series, more
and more people will get to
see how
amazing I am, right?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Ding ding ding ding! That's right! ♪

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, I can't wait! I wanna get in a G1 race
already! I wanna hear from
everyone that
I'm the most amazingest racer ever!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her every word brimming with excited
anticipation, Teio never once
seems to
consider the possibility that she might
lose.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But to be honest, after seeing her run, I'm
having a hard time
imagining her ever
losing too.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Oh yeah, we were still doing your test. So,
is this all you got for
today? Cooldown
time already?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: There is one last thing that'll help me really see her true potential.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
The 2500-meter? I'm good at that! Oh I
get it, you wanna see me at
my best, don't
you?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Okay then! Here I go! ♪

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant... How'd I do?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Whoa, a new personal best! Let's go! ♪

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
2500 meters... Among the G1 races, that
would be equal to the
length of the Arima
Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Wh-whoa! Prez?!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
What are you doing here? Have you come
to see me?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: More or less.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
My apologies for interrupting your
regimen, Trainer, but might you
measure
my time as well?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: The same distance as Teio—2500 meters.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Wait, you're gonna run one too? Woohoo!
You don't mind, do you,
Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Thank you. I'll be off, then.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Phew...
Trainer, my time?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Prez... That's two whole seconds faster
than me...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Indeed. I've bested you, Teio.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Yep, I lose! You really are incredible! The
very best racer ever!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Is there nothing else you wish to say?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Huh? Like what?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Well... Allow me to drive the point home.
Teio, you have just lost to
me.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Uhh... I mean, yeah... That's why I
was saying how amazing you
are... Huh?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Right... Sorry for the interruption.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Teio, you're done with training, yes? How
about you go for a
cooldown jog and
enjoy the fresh air?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Uh, okay! Will do! Later, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Now then... I have a question for you,
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
What do you make of Teio's reaction just
now?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's a little hard to think in Rudolf's
imposing presence, but let's see...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Teio shows impressive talent and ambition,
but because she puts her
role model on
such a high pedestal, losing didn't faze her
in the
slightest.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...Wasting her potential, you say? The
school was right to hire you as
a trainer,
with that perceptive eye of yours.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I agree... Teio's current mindset is only
holding her back. Truly
regretful to see in
one with such lofty ambitions.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Hm... You know what? I'd like to ask a
favor of you.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
You see, I plan to have a race with Teio
soon...
